description_en: Queries the information about an auto stop policy for a specific idle instance
description_zh: 获取指定实例的闲置自动关机策略
name: GetIdleInstanceCuller

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470439.html to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

Code.description_en:
The status code. Valid values:

InternalError: an internal error. All errors, except for parameter validation errors, are classified as internal errors.

ValidationError: a parameter validation error
Code.description_zh:
状态码，可能值：
InternalError：内部错误（除了参数验证错误外的其他错误，目前都归类到内部错误）。
ValidationError：参数验证错误

CpuPercentThreshold.description_en: The CPU utilization threshold. Unit: percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. If the CPU utilization of the instance is lower than this threshold, the instance is considered idle
CpuPercentThreshold.description_zh: CPU使用率阈值，单位是百分比，取值1~100，低于此值则认为实例当前处于闲置

GpuPercentThreshold.description_en: The GPU utilization threshold. Unit: percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter takes effect only if the instance is of the GPU instance type. If both CPU and GPU utilization is lower than the thresholds, the instance is considered idle
GpuPercentThreshold.description_zh: GPU使用率阈值，单位是百分比，取值1~100。如果实例为GPU类型，则此参数生效。CPU和GPU同时低于阈值则认为指定实例处于闲置

IdleTimeInMinutes.description_en: The time duration for which the instance is idle. Unit: minutes
IdleTimeInMinutes.description_zh: 实例当前闲置时长，单位是分钟

MaxIdleTimeInMinutes.description_en: The maximum time duration for which the instance is idle. Unit: minutes. If the time duration for which the instance is idle exceeds this value, the system automatically stops the instance
MaxIdleTimeInMinutes.description_zh: 闲置等待时间阈值，单位是分钟。如果闲置时长超过此值，将自动停止DSW实例

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

true

false
Success.description_zh:
成功标志，可能值：
true
false
